summary: Same converged whole-branch autoreview pass, security lens - the dominant lens across all 3 rounds. Trust boundary now explicit: acting-identity fields (personId, jobId) are host-stamped from the spawn-time run registry and never parsed from the worker payload; the unit test forges both and asserts the overwrite. Scheduled grants resolve the person from the host-persisted job row and FAIL CLOSED on an unresolvable job. DM approval authority is the DM participant (0118); PERM-2 preserved - the worker never self-grants; grants are written only after a human decision.
residual_risks: Accepted (0118, confirmed by Ravi): on a shared agent folder a compromised worker inherits the same exposure person-scoped memory already accepts; the elaborate trusted-contract machinery defending this was deliberately removed.
Registry-miss edge retains the worker jobId so legitimate scheduled requests keep the fail-closed path; the forge endpoint on that edge equals the always-shared alternative.
